      Summary
      
      
      Reads products, colours, sizes, sales and stock, then reports each category and product with sell-through and a recommendation.
      
      
      
      
      
        Data source
        
      
          
          
        
      
      
      
      
      
        
      
          Not connected to Power BI.
          
          
          
        
      
        
        
        
        
          
        Fields
        
          
        Detected automatically from the report's data model. Change any field if needed; the choice is remembered for this report. Values are summed; for a measure or custom expression choose “Measure or DAX…”.
        
          
        
          
        
          
        
          
        
            
        
          
        
          
        Reports
        
          
        Design the reports users can open from this summary, using any columns of the report's data. Users only choose the report and the period. Choose who sees each report in “Visible to”.
        
          
        
          
        
          
        
            
        
              
        
              
        
            
        
            
        
            
        Group by
        
            
        
            
            
        Filters
        Users can always filter by the Group by columns. Add other columns users may filter by, for example Branch, Season or Colour.
        
            
        
            
            
        Values
        Totals are added up day by day, so use columns or measures that can be summed (quantities, amounts). For stock use “Current value”. For averages or rates use a ratio of two values, e.g. Net sales ÷ Units sold.
